subject: Your HatchGrab demo — here’s your link
heading: Your demo is ready
intro: Here’s the link to the demo we built from your menu. Order from it like one of your customers, then watch the order arrive on your kitchen screen. No login needed — just tap it.
deletion: This is a demo, so we don’t keep it: we’ll delete it, and the menu you uploaded, on {date}. If you’d like longer, press “Save my menu” in the demo and we’ll keep it for 14 days.
deletionSoon: This is a demo, so we don’t keep it: we’ll delete it, and the menu you uploaded, after 24 hours. If you’d like longer, press “Save my menu” in the demo and we’ll keep it for 14 days.
